description:
Perform a Near Duplicate Content audit on 'https://crawler-test.com/'. 

STEPS:
1. Open Screaming Frog SEO Spider.
2. Go to Configuration > Content > Duplicates and check 'Enable Near Duplicates'. Set the Near Duplicate Similarity Threshold to '90%'.
3. Crawl 'https://crawler-test.com/'.
4. CRITICAL: When the crawl finishes, you MUST run 'Crawl Analysis' (Analysis menu > Start) for near duplicates to be calculated. Wait for the analysis progress bar to reach 100%.
5. Navigate to the 'Content' tab and select 'Near Duplicates' from the filter dropdown.
6. Export this specific view to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/near_duplicates.csv'.
7. Create a text report at '~/Documents/SEO/reports/similarity_analysis.txt' noting the number of duplicate groups found and the highest similarity percentage observed.
